title: Implement biometric retention and deletion workflows

environment.profile: local acceptance on Darwin arm64; synthetic fixtures only

BIO-BIO-009-AC01.finding: Tenant/category retention policies are configurable behind verified actor provenance and real tenant-scoped permission grants.

BIO-BIO-009-AC02.finding: Deletion writes immutable requested and terminal audit events around the real template deletion workflow.

BIO-BIO-009-AC03.finding: Raw-image retention defaults off and BIO-BIO-002 enforces the tenant authority at the capture write boundary, failing closed on denial or authority failure.

BIO-BIO-009-AC04.finding: Deletion propagates to galleries using record-derived identity; restart-surviving pending cleanup and ambiguity-safe verification preserve recovery obligations while immutable audit metadata has no delete surface.

BIO-BIO-009-AC05.finding: The fingerprints surface connects through BiometricService in a documented HYBRID state: SIMULATION proves the human workflow and real-server LIVE tests prove unauthenticated calls fail closed with visible 400/401 errors. Authorized-success and unprivileged-deny LIVE workflows must be re-verified when TD-WEB-PROVENANCE-BRIDGE ships.

open_follow_up_obligations.required_action: Re-open/re-verify BIO-BIO-009 against real web and API servers: prove an authorized browser session successfully updates retention policy and deletes a biometric record, and prove an unprivileged browser session is denied.
open_follow_up_obligations.current_negative_proof: Real-server LIVE tests prove proof-less browser calls are rejected before mutation and the UI surfaces the error without hanging.

open_follow_up_obligations.trigger: Biometric retention runs in multiple processes sharing one cleanup-store path
open_follow_up_obligations.required_action: Replace the single-instance SemaphoreSlim coordination with shared storage or an inter-process lock so concurrent read-modify-write cannot lose a pending cleanup obligation.

final_acceptance.reason: AC01-AC04 and the documented AC05 HYBRID boundary map to exact-commit implementation, builder evidence and independent QA/security PASS reviews. Fresh traceability, module-direction and secret checks pass. Acceptance preserves the mandatory positive authorized and unprivileged-deny LIVE re-verification when TD-WEB-PROVENANCE-BRIDGE lands and the documented single-process cleanup-store constraint.
